NAV.NO_MATCH: No setting matches. Try another word.

SHADOW_DETAIL.sla: Late conversations get a label and a private note. Customers see nothing.
SHADOW_DETAIL.recovery: Follow-ups are drafted as private notes. Nothing is sent to the lead.
SHADOW_DETAIL.broadcasts: Preview and runs show exactly who would receive it. Nothing is sent.
SHADOW_DETAIL.sms: Tolzar shows the exact SMS it would send through your provider. No SMS leaves.
SHADOW_DETAIL.crm: Every run lists what would change in your CRM. Nothing is written there.
SHADOW_DETAIL.commerce: Tolzar reads your catalogue and order status only. Nothing is changed in the shop.
SHADOW_DETAIL.order_chat: Order status is read for this channel and answered in Shadow: the AI drafts, nothing is sent.
SHADOW_DETAIL.documents: The text is read for triage only and never stored.
SHADOW_DETAIL.tuning: Proposals only: nothing in the agent changes until you copy an approved edit yourself.
SHADOW_DETAIL.meta_app: Pages connect listen-only: Tolzar receives, your team keeps answering in Meta Business Suite.
SHADOW_DETAIL.whatsapp_listen: Tolzar only receives this number's messages. It never sends on it.
